title: failsafe
description: Fire the Asset's failsafe, as if a failsafe rule had fired. It is always sent with now. The Asset stops current work, clears its queue, and enters failsafe state for the rest of the operation. It runs the highest-priority rule with a commanded condition whose other conditions hold, or, with none, its built-in safe action, as a failsafe Task. The Task completes once the Asset is in failsafe state; the response reports its own outcome in report.failsafe. An Asset already in failsafe state refuses it. It is never a failsafe response.
